1. Relevance to My Project Section

LegalSight is an enterprise-grade AI contract intelligence and legal risk analysis platform. In enterprise legal operations, contracts govern hundreds of millions of dollars in financial commitments, intellectual property assignments, and cross-border liability. Software failures in this domain carry serious financial and regulatory consequences: an uncapped indemnification clause missed, an ambiguous governing law designation, or an unrecorded redline can expose an enterprise to catastrophic damages.

Automated Selenium E2E & Storyboarder testing is critical to LegalSight for four core reasons:

  • High-Stakes Legal Verification: Confirms that extracted clauses, calculated liability ceilings, and suggested redlines in the UI match the backend neural inference models (Stanford CUAD / MAUD) with 100% fidelity.
  • Deterministic Role-Based Access Control (RBAC): Guarantees that only authorized General Counsel or Senior Contract Analysts can edit redlines or mint legal seals, while Guest/Viewer accounts are strictly read-only.
  • Non-Repudiation & Cryptographic Traceability: Validates the end-to-end chain of custody from initial contract ingestion to digital legal seal minting and SHA-256 audit ledger logging.
  • Visual Auditability via "Storyboarder": Instead of passing silently in a terminal, Storyboarder captures chronological, high-resolution visual evidence of each user action, creating an audit-ready trail for legal and compliance stakeholders.

2. How I Integrated It Section

The testing architecture bridges the live React 19 / Vite frontend (http://localhost:5173) and FastAPI backend (http://127.0.0.1:8000) with an automated Selenium WebDriver harness:

+-------------------------------+ +-------------------------------+ | FastAPI Backend (Port 8000) | <=================> | React 19 Frontend (Pt 5173) | +-------------------------------+ +-------------------------------+ ^ | (DOM Events & Assertions) +-------------------------------+ | Selenium WebDriver 4.51.0 | +-------------------------------+ ^ | (Snapshots, Timers, Logs) +-------------------------------+ | Storyboarder Engine (core) | +-------------------------------+ ^ | (Subprocess Execution) +-------------------------------+ | Master Runner (orchestrator) | +-------------------------------+

Technical Integration Blueprint:

  1. Storyboarder Engine (storyboarder.py): Manages the Chrome WebDriver instance, locking the viewport to an enterprise standard 1440x900. Wraps each test step in storyboard.step(), recording millisecond-accurate timestamps, measuring rendering latency, and saving PNG viewports to disk. Employs smart polling via WebDriverWait with expected conditions.
  2. Toast Notification Bypass: Fixed React 19 notification overlays that intercepted clicks by applying pointer-events: none to .toast-item containers (with pointer-events: auto on close buttons), allowing clicks to pass through freely to underlying tabs and inputs.
  3. Resilient DOM Test Hooks: Tagged critical interactive elements with dedicated data-testid attributes (playbook-item-m-a-aggressive, btn-open-signoff, input-signoff-name, holographic-legal-seal).
  4. Clean Session Teardown: Automatically clears localStorage and sessionStorage between test runs, ensuring total test isolation without state contamination.
  5. Headless Chrome CDP PDF Generation (generate_pdf_report.py): Automatically compiles all terminal logs and 49 Base64-encoded screenshots into an HTML print template, calling Chrome's CDP command Page.printToPDF to generate a vector-grade, print-ready PDF document.

4. How to Run It Section

Prerequisites: Backend running on http://127.0.0.1:8000 and Frontend on http://localhost:5173.

Run All 10 Suites via Master Orchestrator:

PS D:\PROJECTS\LegalSight> python run_storyboard.py

Run Any Individual Test Suite:

PS D:\PROJECTS\LegalSight> python -m tests.e2e.test_01_auth_flow
PS D:\PROJECTS\LegalSight> python -m tests.e2e.test_02_dashboard_ingest
PS D:\PROJECTS\LegalSight> python -m tests.e2e.test_03_reviewer_analysis
PS D:\PROJECTS\LegalSight> python -m tests.e2e.test_10_end_to_end_journey

Toggle Headless vs. Visual Mode (Watch Chrome Open & Click Live):

In tests/e2e/storyboarder.py line 40, set headless: bool = False.

Re-compile the High-Resolution Master PDF:

PS D:\PROJECTS\LegalSight> python generate_pdf_report.py

7. User Experience Storyboard

The Journey of Senior Corporate Counsel Alexandra Vance:

  1. Intake & Portfolio Scoping: Alexandra opens LegalSight. The dashboard displays 42 active contracts, aggregate portfolio liability, and high-risk flags across departments.
  2. Secure Authentication: She authenticates as Senior Contract Analyst. The navigation updates with her credentials, unlocking redlining permissions.
  3. Risk Playbook Selection: Reviewing a high-stakes transaction, she selects the M&A Aggressive playbook, automatically tightening risk tolerance thresholds.
  4. Contract Ingestion: She uploads a 4,200-word SaaS Master Agreement; the neural pipeline segments the document into 12 discrete provisions in under 1.5 seconds.
  5. Split-Pane Review: In the Reviewer studio, the left pane displays the original contract text, while the right pane flags an uncapped indemnification provision.
  6. One-Click Redlining: The AI suggests market-standard compromise language capping liability at 12 months of paid fees; Alexandra accepts with one click.
  7. Certified Seal Minting: She clicks Sign Off, enters her bar credentials, and affirms the review. The system computes an SHA-256 hash and renders a verified Gold Holographic Legal Seal.
  8. Operational Translation: Alexandra switches to Smart Contracts, where the system compiles payment gates and SLA uptime conditions into Solidity 0.8.24 code, ready for deployment.
  9. Compliance Assurance: Alexandra checks the Audit Ledger. Her sign-off, redlines, and seal creation are permanently logged with cryptographic timestamps for SEC and corporate audit readiness.

8. Working of LegalSight Section

[ Ingested Contract ] | v [ Transformer Pipeline (Stanford CUAD / MAUD) ] | +---> [ Clause Segmentation & NER Extraction ] +---> [ Risk Scoring vs. Selected Playbook ] +---> [ Automated Redline Generation ] | v [ Counsel Interactive Review (Split-Pane Studio) ] | +---> Accept / Reject Redlines +---> Affirm Sign-Off | v [ Cryptographic Engine ] ---> [ Mints Certified Holographic Legal Seal (SHA-256) ] | +---> [ Solidity 0.8.24 Smart Contract Synthesis (EVM State Rules) ] +---> [ Append-Only Compliance Ledger (Immutable Audit Trail) ]
  1. Ingestion & Normalization: LegalSight accepts raw legal text, PDF, and DOCX files, normalizing them into standardized tokens.
  2. Clause Extraction & Classification: Transformer models fine-tuned on Stanford CUAD (510 contracts across 41 categories) and MAUD identify clauses and extract entities such as governing jurisdictions, notice deadlines, and liability caps.
  3. Playbook-Driven Risk Analysis: Extracted clauses are benchmarked against dynamic playbooks (e.g., M&A Aggressive vs. Vendor Standard) to compute a normalized risk score (0 to 100).
  4. Redline Suggestion Engine: Deviations from standard terms trigger counter-proposals based on market benchmarks.
  5. Cryptographic Seal: Counsel sign-off generates a tamper-evident digital seal incorporating counsel credentials, contract digest, and timestamp.
  6. Solidity Synthesis: Contractual commitments (e.g., uptime SLAs, escrow releases) are translated into Solidity 0.8.24 smart contracts for decentralized execution.
  7. Compliance Ledger: Every action is indexed in an immutable audit ledger with SHA-256 hashes to guarantee complete traceability.

9. How the Storyboard Images Represent the Project

Each screenshot in the storyboard visually represents a key functional pillar of LegalSight:

  • Dashboard & Portfolio Telemetry (test_02_dashboard_ingest): Shows executive-level risk visibility across contract portfolios, demonstrating speed and real-time intake telemetry.
  • Split-Pane Reviewer Interface (test_03_reviewer_analysis): Highlights deep contract intelligence by placing the raw source agreement next to extracted risk cards and NER metadata.
  • Visual Redline Comparison (test_03_reviewer_analysis): Illustrates automated negotiation defense, showing how aggressive legal language is replaced with balanced counter-terms.
  • Certified Holographic Legal Seal (test_03_reviewer_analysis, test_10_end_to_end_journey): Represents legal authority, verifiability, and non-repudiation through a gold cryptographic stamp.
  • Solidity Code Studio & Sepolia Simulation (test_07_smart_contracts): Demonstrates legal automation by bridging legal covenants with algorithmic on-chain execution.
  • Cryptographic Audit Ledger (test_09_audit_ledger): Represents enterprise-grade compliance and governance through a tamper-evident chronological event log.
